3d.label: 3D
3d.prompt: Use one coherent 3D rendering treatment. If the user only specifies 3D and does not name a sub-style, freely choose either a stylized 3D animation treatment or a realistic 3D human-render treatment, but do not mix them across cells. Preserve stable identity and proportions, consistent materials, clothing, lighting cues, and recognizable features throughout the sheet. Avoid switching renderers between cells or adding a generic scene around the character.

realistic.label: 电影感写实
realistic.prompt: Use cinematic semi-realistic character rendering with natural anatomy, skin or fur and fabric detail, photographic lighting, and restrained expression exaggeration. Preserve facial structure, body proportions, clothing, materials, and recognizable identity. Avoid big-head chibi proportions, glossy vinyl surfaces, and flat cartoon linework.

hand-drawn.label: 暖色手绘
hand-drawn.prompt: Use warm hand-drawn doodle illustration with wobbly notebook lines, naive anatomy, spontaneous roughness, softly textured color, and readable silhouettes while preserving the reference IP. Avoid polished 3D rendering, perfect vector geometry, and photorealistic materials.

chibi.label: 虹彩 Q 版
chibi.prompt: Use a clean big-head chibi character design with the head at 50–65 percent of total height, a tiny torso, very short arms and feet, rounded shapes, clear facial reactions, and stable simplified details. Use luminous pastel materials only as a finishing accent; keep the proportion change as the primary style cue. Avoid natural adult anatomy and realistic body scale.

manga.label: 国潮漫画
manga.prompt: Use extreme anime reaction language with shock marks, speed lines, stress veins, waterfall tears, expressive eyes, decisive ink contours, selective cel shading, and exaggerated facial distortion. Keep every reaction instantly readable. Avoid generic polished 3D and decorative accents without a changed facial or pose reaction.

pixel-art.label: 精细像素
pixel-art.prompt: Use crisp 8/16-bit pixel-art clusters with a consistent limited palette, a readable game-sprite silhouette, deliberate blocky edges, and expressive animation-ready poses. Stage reactions like game abilities or power-ups without smoothing the pixels. Avoid painterly gradients, anti-aliased 3D edges, and photographic texture.

cute.label: 软萌毛绒
cute.prompt: Use a soft plush character treatment with soft short fur, a gentle warm palette, rounded stuffed silhouette, appealing expressions, tactile but simplified fibers, charming gesture language, and clean sticker readability. Avoid molded plastic shine, clay fingerprints, and detailed cinematic fur rendering.

caricature-3d.label: 夸张 3D 肖像
caricature-3d.prompt: Use a polished 3D caricature portrait with recognizable facial structure, an intentionally enlarged head, compact body proportions, expressive features, studio lighting, and restrained clean accents. Make the facial likeness and scale contrast carry the style. Avoid blind-box surface simplification and ordinary full-body 3D realism.

fashion-realistic.label: 时尚写实
fashion-realistic.prompt: Use glossy fashion-oriented semi-realistic rendering with faithful facial identity, refined hair and fabric, beauty lighting, editorial posing, and minimal decorative accents. Keep the styling deliberate and studio-like while preserving the character's original clothing identity. Avoid chibi proportions, toy molding, and chaotic reaction graphics.

mascot-toy.label: 品牌玩具吉祥物
mascot-toy.prompt: Use a designer vinyl-toy and blind-box figure aesthetic with smooth molded surfaces, bold color blocking, simplified geometric construction, compact collectible proportions, short limbs, and readable expressions. Keep accents local and product-like. Avoid fibrous fur, clay fingerprints, painterly brushwork, and realistic anatomy.

clay-cute.label: 软陶萌宠
clay-cute.prompt: Use a hand-sculpted soft-clay character with sculpted rounded volumes, matte clay reflection, subtle fingerprint texture, creamy materials, warm pastel patches, gentle studio light, and highly readable facial reactions. Preserve the character identity through color, face, clothing, and silhouette. Avoid glossy vinyl surfaces and individual fur-strand rendering.

fantasy-plush.label: 奇幻毛绒
fantasy-plush.prompt: Use a fantasy plush character style with tactile fur, a compact heroic costume, localized magical accents, whimsical accessories, soft cinematic lighting, and playful but coherent material details. Keep the magical evidence attached to the character and inside its cell. Avoid an unrelated fantasy scene or replacing the original identity.

kawaii-anime.label: 日系萌系
kawaii-anime.prompt: Use polished kawaii anime linework with large expressive eyes, clean soft linework, glossy hair highlights, pastel color accents, compact proportions, and restrained reaction accents. Keep the eyes and line quality as the primary style cues. Avoid 3D fur, realistic lighting, thick comic ink, and oversized emoji anatomy.

retro.label: 复古风（兼容）
retro.prompt: Use a retro-inspired illustration treatment with period-evocative color separation, tactile print texture, bold simplified shapes, and nostalgic finishing. Keep the print treatment inside the character artwork and preserve the original identity. Avoid modern glossy 3D rendering and full-cell background plates.

retro-halftone.label: 复古漫画网点风
retro-halftone.prompt: Use retro pop-comic rendering with Ben-Day dots, slight internal CMYK misregistration, restricted graphic colors, bold ink shapes, and forceful reaction language. Keep all halftone and registration texture inside the character artwork. Avoid smooth 3D shading, photographic texture, and a separate comic-panel background.

ink-wash-meme.label: 水墨 Meme 风
ink-wash-meme.prompt: Use a Chinese ink-wash character with dry/wet ink variation, expressive brush economy, restrained brush lines, ample transparent negative space, and understated modern humor. Keep the ink variation contained within the figure while preserving the character's identity. Avoid full opaque paper backgrounds, glossy 3D rendering, and dense decorative scenery.

emoji-hybrid.label: Emoji 混合风
emoji-hybrid.prompt: Transform the approved character into an Emoji-character hybrid, not a standard 3D character with Emoji decorations. Use a recognizable character face combined with glossy three-dimensional Emoji body language, smooth rounded body volumes, simplified color blocks, oversized readable eyes, brows, mouth and paws or hands, and immediate chat readability. Let the enlarged facial features and whole-body gesture carry each reaction; keep compact Emoji-like accents secondary. Preserve the character's identity markers such as face pattern, ears, fur or hair colors, clothing colors, and signature accessories, while reducing strand-level texture only where it blocks Emoji clarity. Avoid ordinary full-body 3D cartoon rendering, cinematic realism, detailed fabric texture, literal Unicode glyphs as the main subject, and scene props.

custom.note: Use custom for long-tail cultural, print, UI, or hybrid styles; it still goes through static approval and the output contract.
